# Kunal Joshi

> Cloud & AI Security Architect (Mumbai, India). Security engineer and AWS cloud
> security architect with 8 years designing, securing, and optimizing
> enterprise-grade systems. Deep specialist in identity & access management and
> applied cryptography (KMS / CloudHSM / PKCS#11), with hands-on delivery for
> regulated financial customers. Increasingly focused on security for AI agent
> systems — identity propagation, delegated authorization, and least-privilege
> for agentic / MCP architectures.

Site: https://joshikunal.com/ — single-page portfolio / body of work.

## Experience

- Cloud Security Architect, Amazon Web Services, Mumbai (May 2024–present):
  customer security architectures across IAM, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty;
  least privilege, MFA, SSO federation, Just-In-Time access; security for
  regulated financial-data workloads.
- Cloud Engineer II – Security, Amazon Web Services, Bangalore (Dec 2017–May 2024):
  SME for AWS IAM (federation, SAML, SSO) and cryptography (KMS, CloudHSM).

## Expertise

- Identity & Access Management (IAM, federation, SAML, OAuth, SSO, JIT)
- Applied cryptography & key management (AWS KMS, CloudHSM, PKCS#11, JCE, OpenSSL engine)
- AWS security architecture & governance
- Cloud-native SIEM / SOC (OpenSearch)
- Emerging: AI / agent security — on-behalf-of token exchange (RFC 8693), A2A & MCP authorization
